claim: Blood lights a door like the room it is in: over the 316 walls facing a Z-motion (type 600) sector in E3M1, E3M2, E1M1, E6M1 and E4M9, the median shade against the median of their own sector's walls is 0 (p10 -8, p90 +6). Directional shading that leaves the door wall black hides the way out.
evidence: projects/blood-city/reports/refinement-log.md:557-563 gave 720 walls, p10 -5, p90 +7 (counted 2026-08-28, not reproduced)
use: After any directional pass, bring door-facing walls back to their room's median shade. Gravesend's lightpools.settle_door_shading did this and has been removed; nothing does it now.

checked.how: Recounted with knowledge/blood/findings/probes/audit2_door_wall_shade.py over E3M1, E3M2, E1M1, E6M1, E4M9: 316 walls of non-door sectors facing a type-600 sector, shade minus their sector's median wall shade: median 0, p10 -8, p90 +6 (the door sectors' own walls against the room: 316 more, median 0, p10 -15, p90 +8). The 720 / -5 / +7 of refinement-log.md:557-563 does not reproduce. settle_door_shading is gone from lightpools.py (grep): no code does it now.
